H3-P2.q: So what do you actually do this month? Start doing some inner pl/ork, with the free [reparenting guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/inner-child-self-love-tips-and-guided) and [Hearthwork manual](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling) or with another serious practice you already trust. And practice before you have an audience!
H3-P2.y: If I were starting this month, I'd start with the inner pl/ork. The free [reparenting guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/inner-child-self-love-tips-and-guided) and [Hearthwork manual](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling) are there for exactly that, or go with another serious practice you already trust. H3-P2.w: Start working on the inner pl/ork. With what? The free [reparenting guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/inner-child-self-love-tips-and-guided) and [Hearthwork manual](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling), or another serious practice you already trust. And practice before you have an audience!

H3-P3.q: Get two or three people together to form a practice group. Call it that, not a commune! Before you start talking about a shared future, meet regularly: practice listening and switching roles, get through at least one disagreement together, and keep your commitments to each other. One disagreement is enough, I promise!
H3-P3.y: Then I'd find two or three people for a practice group (I'd call it that, not a commune). We'd meet regularly, and learn to listen, switch roles, get through one disagreement and keep our commitments, all before anybody talked about a shared future. One disagreement is enough!

H3-P4: Where can you find some of these people? Are there any unprogrammed Quaker meetings near you? How about restorative-practice groups? Maybe there's an open-hearted congregation, or a mature recovery group, or a meditation group you can check out. Or maybe you know someone who came back from a long retreat kinder, rather than more impressed with themselves.
